# DSCodex

> DSCodex is an open-source loopback router that adds DeepSeek V4.1 Flash to the model picker of the stock ChatGPT desktop app, Codex CLI, and Codex IDE extension while keeping GPT on ChatGPT OAuth, including the desktop app's Responses WebSocket. It runs only on the user's machine and does not fork or patch Codex.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/fish2lab/DSCodex
Latest release: https://github.com/fish2lab/DSCodex/releases/tag/v1.3.0
License: MIT

DSCodex is not DeepSeek's official Codex setup (that setup replaces GPT with an API-key provider). It is not DSCode (https://github.com/thinkany-ai/dscode), not DeepCodex, not CLIProxyAPI, and not a chatgpt.com web plugin.

## Key facts

- Picker entry: `🐳 DeepSeek Flash` (slug `deepseek/deepseek-flash`, wire name `deepseek-flash`, currently DeepSeek V4.1 Flash)
- DeepSeek path: native Responses API over HTTP at `api.deepseek.com/responses` (tool loops, native vision, encrypted compaction). DeepSeek is never forwarded onto OpenAI's WebSocket.
- GPT path: OAuth passthrough to `chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex`, HTTP SSE and Responses WebSocket (`ws://127.0.0.1:10110/<token>/v1/responses` proxied to `wss://chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/responses`). If the loopback router is down, the ChatGPT desktop app shows Reconnecting 1/5…5/5.
- Install: `npm install` → `node src/cli.mjs key set` → `install` → `start` → `doctor` (six checks). Runtime dependency: `ws`.
- Platforms: macOS / Linux / Windows; the ChatGPT desktop picker integration is macOS-first
- Reasoning effort: the catalog exposes High (`high`, Juice 75) and Max (`max`, Juice 100; picker default). The router folds `low`/`medium`/`high` to `high` and everything else to `max`. The hosted DeepSeek API rejects integer Juice 1–100 and `ultra` with HTTP 400.

## Optional

- [v1.3.0 — Live Model List](https://github.com/fish2lab/DSCodex/releases/tag/v1.3.0): the picker follows the live ChatGPT model list (new GPT models appear, retired ones leave); uninstall works after Codex drops the marker comment
- [v1.2.2 — Spawn and Switch](https://github.com/fish2lab/DSCodex/releases/tag/v1.2.2): sub-agents on DeepSeek, DeepSeek → GPT switch fixed again (#23), instant 426 fallback for DeepSeek WebSocket handshakes
- [v1.2.1 — Keep the Wire](https://github.com/fish2lab/DSCodex/releases/tag/v1.2.1): official GPT Responses WebSocket passthrough so ChatGPT desktop reconnects; DeepSeek stays on HTTP Responses
- [v1.2.0 — From the New World](https://github.com/fish2lab/DSCodex/releases/tag/v1.2.0): V4.1 Flash, native vision, DeepSeek → GPT replay fix, router recovery
- [Official DeepSeek Codex setup](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/agent_integrations/codex/): the alternative that does not keep GPT
